photos.title: The Sea Mist condo lot from above
photos.what: The Sea Mist condo lot from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the towers of the condo lot stand on the beach at the center, with the dot at the lot center; a hotel tower with a Y-shaped roof stands to the upper right; a water park lies across the street at the upper left; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Sea Mist condo lot from above, on the beach at South Ocean Boulevard.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Sea Mist condo lot on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the Atlantic Ocean along the right
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
